details.question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
details.sql:
WITH eur_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM customers WHERE currency = 'EUR'
),
czk_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM customers WHERE currency = 'CZK'
)
SELECT
  eur_customers.count * 1.0 / czk_customers.count as ratio
FROM eur_customers, czk_customers

details.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
details.sql:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        ym.date,
        ym.consumption,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym.date) as year
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym.date) >= 2012
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym.date) <= 2013
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
segment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END) as consumption_2012,
        AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END) as consumption_2013,
        ROUND(((AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END)) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) as percentage_increase
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
),
ranked_stats AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        percentage_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC) as rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM segment_stats
)
SELECT segment, percentage_increase, rank_desc, rank_asc FROM ranked_stats WHERE rank_desc = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT segment, percentage_increase, rank_desc, rank_asc FROM ranked_stats WHERE rank_asc = 1
ORDER BY rank_desc DESC, rank_asc ASC

WITH product_transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.productid,
    p.description,
    COUNT(t.transactionid) as transaction_count,
    SUM(t.amount) as total_amount
  FROM products p
  JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.productid = t.productid
  GROUP BY p.productid, p.description
)
SELECT

FROM product_transaction_counts

details.question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
details.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT
        c.customerid,
        c.currency,
        SUM(t.amount) as total_spending,
        COUNT(t.productid) as item_count
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid

)
SELECT

    cs.currency,

    cs.item_count,

FROM customer_spending cs
ORDER BY cs.total_spending DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
details.sql:
WITH min_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        MIN(y.consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND y.date < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT
        m.segment,
        c.customerid
    FROM min_consumption m
    JOIN customers c ON c.segment = m.segment
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND y.date < '2014-01-01'
    AND y.consumption = m.min_cons
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        AVG(y.consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumers mc
    JOIN yearmonth y ON mc.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE y.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND y.date < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
    s1.segment AS segment1,
    s2.segment AS segment2,
    s1.avg_consumption - s2.avg_consumption AS difference
FROM segment_averages s1
JOIN segment_averages s2 ON s1.segment < s2.segment
ORDER BY s1.segment, s2.segment

details.question: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
details.sql:
WITH SME_customers AS (
    SELECT customerid
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment = 'SME'
),
currency_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.currency,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid) as customer_count
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN SME_customers sc ON c.customerid = sc.customerid
    WHERE c.currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
    GROUP BY c.currency
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN customer_count ELSE 0 END) as czk_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN customer_count ELSE 0 END) as eur_count
    FROM currency_counts
)
SELECT
    czk_count,
    eur_count,
    CASE WHEN czk_count > eur_count THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END as is_more_czk,
    czk_count - eur_count as difference
FROM summary

details.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
details.sql:
WITH min_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        MIN(y.consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND y.date < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT
        m.segment,
        c.customerid
    FROM min_consumption m
    JOIN customers c ON c.segment = m.segment
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND y.date < '2014-01-01'
    AND y.consumption = m.min_cons
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        AVG(y.consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumers mc
    JOIN yearmonth y ON mc.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE y.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND y.date < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
    s1.segment AS segment1,
    s2.segment AS segment2,
    s1.avg_consumption - s2.avg_consumption AS difference
FROM segment_averages s1
JOIN segment_averages s2 ON s1.segment < s2.segment
ORDER BY s1.segment, s2.segment

details.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
details.sql:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        ym.date,
        ym.consumption,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym.date) as year
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym.date) >= 2012
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym.date) <= 2013
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
segment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END) as consumption_2012,
        AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END) as consumption_2013,
        ROUND(((AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END)) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN consumption ELSE NULL END), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) as percentage_increase
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
),
ranked_stats AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        percentage_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC) as rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM segment_stats
)
SELECT segment, percentage_increase, rank_desc, rank_asc FROM ranked_stats WHERE rank_desc = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT segment, percentage_increase, rank_desc, rank_asc FROM ranked_stats WHERE rank_asc = 1
ORDER BY rank_desc DESC, rank_asc ASC

details.question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
details.sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.customerid,
        SUM(t.amount) as total_spending,
        c.currency
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid
    GROUP BY c.customerid, c.currency
    ORDER BY total_spending DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tc.customerid,
    AVG(t.price) as avg_price_per_item,
    tc.currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN transactions_1k t ON tc.customerid = t.customerid
WHERE t.customerid = tc.customerid
GROUP BY tc.customerid, tc.currency
